title: Blow Mould Operator
description:
Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea is one of PNG’s largest food companies, manufacturing and distributing high-quality Flour, Stock Feed, Rice, Snacks and Bakery products throughout the country. Well-known products and brands include Flame Flour, Flame Stockfeed, Flame Oil & Sugar, Flame Rice, Bilas Bread, Skel Rice, Twisties snacks, Arthurs Pies, and the Meadow Lea range.
At GFI, we care about making everyday food better for everyone.
Our goal is to be the leading and most innovative food company with a mission to meet our customers’ needs for superior quality foods with brands that are trusted by families everywhere.  We are the go-to source of consumer, shopper, and customer insights to help our customer and business partners succeed.
We currently have vacancies for
Blow Mould Operators
to join our already strong and vibrant
Oil Bottling Plant (Production) Team
in
Lae
.
Reporting to the
Shift Supervisor
,
the successful incumbent will set up the blow moulding machine, observe its operation, ensuring the blown bottles meet specifications and execute changeovers and troubleshoot problems for repairs and maintenance.
Your
responsibilities
will include
:
Be on time for shift pre-start checks and ensure machine is in safe and correct operating mode.
Align production plan and execute changeover within specified time frame.
Report all machine abnormal functions
Perform Cleaning, lubrication & basic Maintenance tasks/assist maintenance team where required
Record and report all required machine data
Punctual at work with minimum absenteeism
Minimise double work & waste of resources
Flexibility to support and relieve work in any other sections as planned by the supervisors.
Ensure to keep machine and work area clean
Takes break as per the standard time – no extended breaks
Maintain a high level of personal hygiene and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
Comply to safe work practices
Perform other tasks as directed by the supervisor
To be considered for the role, you will need to have/ be
:
High Literacy and Numeracy skill level
Knowledge of blowing process parameters
Understand the heating and blowing relationship
Ability to reprocess parameters
Ability to troubleshoot failures
Ability to analyze data to make decisions
Minimum grade 12 education or TVET qualification in Mechanical or Electrical
Over 3 years of experience with blow moulding operation
Working knowledge and experience with high-pressure compressors.
Actively comply with Safety WALK’s and TALK’s according to the schedule.
Wear the correct Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and safety equipment required in designated areas (100% compliance).
Comply with all safety, quality and Goodman Fielder policies and practices.
Be part of the Skel life and join a team that values healthy eating and active lifestyles and wants to share that with all the people of PNG.  Still interested? Send your letter of application and CV/resume with at least 2 referees to:

Goodman Fielder Papua New Guine
